clusters.title: The shipped learned detector's model spec is gitignored: every fresh clone gets a broken .mlpackage, a different provenance hash, and a red unit gate
Ptychography scan positions ignore the calibrated R–Q rotation and transpose
H5Reader's three attribute readers read the whole attribute into a fixed-size scalar buffer — a multi-element HDF5 attribute overruns it
Learned detector: the edge-exclusion rule is applied to each 256 px model window, so on detectors > 256 px there are blind bands at every window seam where no window will accept a peak
The parallax aberration fit silently ignores the app's own calibrated detector transpose; the code path that would apply it is unreachable
A multi-`data_` CIF is silently merged into one crystal: cell parameters from the last block, atom sites and symmetry operations concatenated from all of them
The CI `inventory` job cannot pass: on a shallow checkout `HEAD^` does not resolve, so the C5 heavy-file check reports the whole 7 509 lines as growth
The shipped detector's public record claims 20 000 training steps; the retained training log shows the 90-minute cap fired at step 6 500
NOTICE claims the bundled HDF5/libaec licence texts ship inside the app; they are absent from the released v2.5.1 artefact and from the repo entirely
The triage's own port recipe for DiffractionEmbedding omits its build prerequisite, which exists only on the branch
The C8 decision to strand the four pure engines rests on a claim the branch's own files and gate rows contradict
The accessibility open item's reason for dropping `.accessibilityLabel()` is contradicted by its own data — the one in-body control that reports a label is the one that restates it
The accessibility crash — the one finding status.md names as able to block v3.0.0 — rests on two crash reports that do not exist on this machine
Three prebuilt Homebrew dylibs are committed and shipped with no recorded provenance, version, hash or rebuild path — and no automated gate ever inspects them

A file- or sidecar-supplied probe radius permanently freezes `minPeakSpacing`: the later measured radius is never adopted, because the "user has not chosen one" guard cannot tell an app-seeded value from a user edit
A replayed DPC step reports `.published` while publishing nothing — the promote run's summary attests to a result that was never produced
`publishProduct` takes the product's pixel size from the CURRENT analysis mode, so the scan-domain detector-disagreement map is published and exported with the Bragg map's reciprocal Å⁻¹/px
Disk-detection staleness signature and recipe omit the probe kernel's identity, so a Bragg map made with a different kernel is reported as current
A single non-finite pixel in a diffraction pattern silently returns zero peaks for that whole pattern
Hexagonal IPF colour key labels ⟨10-1̄0⟩ and ⟨11-2̄0⟩ the wrong way round — green and blue are swapped against the crystallography
Float32 running sum saturates: whole-stack mean collapses on ordinary-sized datasets
`RotationCalibration` — the R/Q rotation AND transpose solver — has zero gated coverage; its only non-app caller is a diagnostic harness that never runs in any gate
Empty scan positions inject Float.greatestFiniteMagnitude into the clustering-scale median
Every full-cube VirtualDetector pass runs on the main actor: AppState never wraps them in Task.detached, and `nonisolated async` inherits the caller's actor under this project's settings
Selected-area diffraction circle mask is half a pixel off-centre from the ROI drawn on screen
Matrix-DFT upsampling assigns the wrong Fourier frequency to one bin on every odd-length axis, biasing every parallax subpixel shift on odd-sized grids
CIF importer applies whatever symmetry-operation list the file happens to contain, with no completeness or consistency check
ACOM CPU matching silently returns an unmatched or partially unmatched orientation map when a per-worker matcher cannot be built — no failure flag, unlike its DiskDetection twin
BraggVectorEMDWriter.readStringAttribute assumes every string attribute is variable-length; a fixed-length one is read as a pointer and then free()d
Exported dim vectors pair a defaulted step of 1 with a real physical unit, manufacturing a calibration that was never measured
A session save silently publishes a stripped sidecar when the existing file cannot be opened, destroying BraggVectors, saved results, the replay record and the labels
`hasEllipse` admits a non-positive semi-axis, so a degenerate ellipse is applied to every Bragg vector while readiness reports "No detector-distortion correction"
DM4 parsing has unguarded trapping Int conversions and an unbounded field loop — a corrupt or desynchronised tag tree kills or hangs the process
DM4 tag parser converts file-supplied UInt64/Double counts to Int without validating them: a malformed .dm4 traps or hangs
Scan-fastest DM4 reads the detector pair in the opposite order from the detector-fastest branch, and the only test covering it is circular
The unit gate's end-to-end fixture and every gated `probeSize` fixture are square and centre-symmetric, so an rx/ry or qx/qy swap is undetectable
A detector smaller than 256 px whose beam is off-centre is silently truncated by the learned frame — part of the detector is never searched
A learned-inference failure on the live overlay is silently answered with CLASSICAL rings while the picker still says Neural net
The tracked >256-px probe-anchor item understates it: nothing gates, warns, or flags a run on a detector larger than 256 px

Hand-clicked disk-centre labels are written with `frame: "native"` but are captured in the loaded view's frame, so labels clicked on a cropped or binned view name the wrong detector pixels and scan positions
CBED PNG export burns a guessed "1/nm" scale-bar label when the file gave a Q pixel size with no units
Candidate views for the AX stack overflow, ranked — the three `.contain` containers that wrap an NSViewRepresentable, and the two labels applied to non-elements
ApertureOverlay's accessibility representation builds a Slider whose ClosedRange can be inverted, trapping the process
Pan clamp is still the dead Metal shader's rule, so a zoomed pane can only pan 1/zoom of the way to the image edge
A DPC unit test turns a total DPC failure into a skip, on the always-available in-memory demo fixture
The ACOM Metal-vs-CPU parity gate compares in-plane angles modulo π, so a 180° divergence in the user-selectable "Metal GPU" backend passes while printing "Metal choices exact"
`run-tests.sh inventory` exits 1 on the current clean tree — tripped by status.md's own "Nothing is uncommitted" sentence — while status.md's gate table claims exit 0
The "AppState never net positive" rule measures two file paths, so AppState growth in any additional `extension AppState` file is invisible — and 630 such lines already exist on ml/disk-detector

`strain-frame-test` generates its golden from whichever py4DSTEM is installed (0.14.17 here) while asserting source-locks against the 0.14.19 pin; its own error text claims a PYTHONPATH that run.sh never sets
The AGPL yolov8n weights are still distributed by the public repository — reachable from `main` — while NOTICE says no third-party weights are distributed
Most of the retained logs and screenshot sets status.md cites as its evidence no longer exist; one row's "screenshots retained in scratchpad/c4c-drive/" is demonstrably false

`ProbeKernel.synthetic` and the trench in `ProbeKernel.measured` use `y < py/2` for the wrapped (fftfreq) coordinate, where the flat route and NumPy use `(py+1)/2` — one row and one column carry the wrong radius on odd-sized detectors
BraggVectorEMDWriter's scalar dataset readers use H5S_ALL into a single stack value with no dataspace check
Disk-centre labels written by a branch build are silently erased by any main build, and vice versa — the two designs use different sidecar attribute names
There is no HDF5 serialisation anywhere, and H5Reader.deinit closes the file off the actor's executor — an entry point the tracked crash item does not name
The CoM kernels clamp negative intensities to zero — an undocumented py4DSTEM deviation that moves every DPC/iDPC and origin number on background-subtracted data
`ml/disk-detector` is 26 commits BEHIND main as well as 27 ahead; its `tools/` tree would resurrect three harnesses main deleted and a 105-line-stale `sources.manifest`
`.github/workflows/ci.yml`'s own description of the inventory job states the opposite of what the script now does — a reader triaging the red job is told size cannot be the cause
CONTRIBUTING.md tells public contributors every Core/ change needs a parity fixture; CLAUDE.md explicitly says the opposite, and recent Core/ sessions followed CLAUDE.md

`Package.swift`'s header says the app target still compiles Core/ and Session/ directly; the project file says it does not, and the 78-path exception list that makes that true is hand-maintained and ungated
Consolidation gate C3 is marked CLOSED but its stated exit criterion fails again on the current status.md, so `/pickup` with no target would re-take a closed gate
The crash reports that are the sole evidence for the repo's top open item are not on this machine
The tracked entry "Two diagnostic harnesses gate nothing" is wrong: nine harnesses gate nothing, and one of them is the sole non-app exerciser of a science port
arm64-only HDF5 with no ARCHS pin: the prescribed Archive release path can produce an x86_64 slice that launches and then fails on every data file

A promote-and-replay from a detector-cropped or binned rehearsal refuses its own strain/ACOM steps: the executor writes re-referenced disk parameters, the staleness check compares them against the un-re-referenced recipe
iDPC integration and the Bragg-vector-map histogram run on the MainActor, the same shape as the P1 freeze this repo already diagnosed one layer up
CIF import runs the whole parse, symmetry expansion and O(n²) family verification synchronously on the main actor, with no cancellation
No staleness signature carries any calibration value, so a re-fitted origin (or a rotation/Q edit) never marks a displayed map stale — the C4(b) plan required exactly this
A signature that cannot be built is reported as "not stale", the same verdict as "matches on every key"
DPC colour-wheel traps (hard crash) on a single non-finite centre-of-mass value
Learned-detector runs record min_absolute_intensity, subpixel and upsample_factor in provenance although refine() applies none of them
Parabolic subpixel refinement runs in Float32 where py4DSTEM explicitly upcasts to float64, with no DEVIATION note
fit1D reports didNotConverge when the seed is already at (or reaches) the optimum
Ellipse calibration cannot be cancelled; the cancellation token only discards the finished result
normalizedResidual carries two incommensurable definitions in one field, gated by near-identical thresholds
Higher-order aberration gradients are sampled at a different angular origin than py4DSTEM
Default alignment schedule drops py4DSTEM's repeat pass at the smallest bin
Alignment working-memory guard counts three stacks; six are live
Parallax and ptychography use the raw aperture centre as the diffraction origin, bypassing `Calibration.referenceOrigin` — the one derivation the type says every caller must use
Parallax and ptychography refuse to run without an R–Q rotation calibration that neither pipeline ever reads
`docs/q-calibration-design.md` documents a probe-radius shell check as the replacement guard, but `KnownCrystalQCalibration.estimate` takes `probeRadiusPixels` and never reads it
probeRadiusPixels is a required argument that no code reads, while its doc comment claims it gates a check

`StrainMapping.compute` scores a manual basis over a different observation population than an automatic one (`minRadius: 0` vs the default 2), so the exported `basis_support_fraction` means two different things
`MetalEngine`'s six compute pipelines are unsynchronized `lazy var`s on a nonisolated process-wide singleton
The azimuthal blur width is a plan-generation parameter but a hard-coded literal in the matcher, so template and experimental images can be built with different kernels
Polar deposition converts a radius to an Int bin index with no finiteness or magnitude guard — a runtime trap on a bad Q calibration
writeCalibration silently discards per-position origin maps that fail its validity test, while the export path refuses on the same condition
Re-referencing wipes `originProvenance` to `.geometricDefault` while a valid recorded mean origin survives and silently becomes the reference origin
DM4 scan shape and voltage are chosen by unscoped substring match over a Dictionary, so which tag wins varies between runs
The demo fixture is square on every axis and declares a symmetric origin, so nothing built on it can catch a scan- or detector-axis transposition
Synthetic demo calibration is stamped .importedFile, so fabricated numbers are labelled as read from a file
Log-scale contrast turns non-finite pixels into a real intensity of 0, breaking the file's own "no data stays distinguishable" invariant
The whole resident-cube path in FourDArray/ResidentCube is unreachable in the shipping app — no caller ever requests .resident
The diffraction-pattern LRU is bounded by pattern COUNT, not bytes, and nothing in the app ever clears it
H5Reader.readProbe materialises the entire probe dataset from file-declared dims, then discards all but slice 0
Rehydrated upsample_factor from a sidecar has no upper bound and reaches an Int(Double) conversion that traps
EMPAD and MIB whole-cube reads open, seek, read and close a fresh FileHandle for every single diffraction pattern
`to_counts` is applied to the cropped window in Swift and to the whole native pattern in Python — an unmarked deviation that gives each >256-px window its own dose scale
Strain staleness ignores the manual g-vector basis, which is an input to the computation
The GPU threadgroup argmax and the CPU argmax break ties in different directions, contradicting the shader's own "identical to the reference path" claim
The app's CoM component order is transposed relative to py4DSTEM, so the R–Q rotation it reports and exports is the negative of py4DSTEM's — and of its own parallax-fitted rotation
Exported figures burn a scale bar with a fabricated unit when the calibration carries a size but no units — the on-screen bar was fixed for this case, the exported one was not

The main-thread regression guard exists only for the learned detector; the classical full-scan path — the shipped default and the one that actually froze the app — has none, and the build cannot catch a lost `nonisolated`
The learned parity gate skips rather than fails on any Core ML load error, and falls back to the repo copy of the asset so a bundle-packaging regression is invisible
Every learned-detector parity test silently XCTSkips when the asset cannot load, because the guard tests only that the .mlpackage DIRECTORY exists
The frozen hand-labelled test set that is the sole evidence for the shipped 0.7 threshold exists only in a `/private/tmp` worktree
The py4DSTEM source lock is verified by HEAD only — a dirty or de-gitted `References/py4DSTEM-dev` is accepted as "lock present"
`fetch-py4dstem.sh` verifies nothing once the checkout exists: no content check without `.git`, and no check at all when HEAD already equals the lock

The inventory's "AppState stored properties" metric counts function-local `let`/`var` and computed properties — it reports 491 where the type declares ~123, and status.md quotes the number as evidence of progress
Merging ml/disk-detector today red-lines main's own inventory gate, and taking the branch's tools/run-tests.sh would silently delete three of its checks
The C5 AppState/ResultExport growth gate is blind whenever HEAD is a docs-only commit, which is this repo's normal closeout shape
Three stale pointers in live docs: an owed push that already happened, a line reference three lines off, and a file path from before the Session/ split
`LearnedDiskDetector.heatmaps` reads the Core ML output as densely packed and never checks its strides or channel count
docs/releasing.md claims the embedded libraries are "free of Homebrew paths"; libhdf5.dylib carries a compiled-in /opt/homebrew plugin search path that the audit does not look for
The shaders are compiled with -fmetal-math-mode=fast, which voids the NaN reasoning written into OriginMeasure.metal and the NaN robustness OriginCalibration claims for the statistics it consumes
ActivityLog's two drop rules are textual heuristics that can silently discard a real event
`AppState.sessionInventory` carries an orphaned doc comment describing a property that was deleted, contradicting the comment directly below it
productWorkflowReadiness probes the app bundle on the filesystem every time a view body reads it
`calibrateEllipse` still hand-rolls the origin fallback that the v2 S13 comment says was eliminated, and centres the fit annulus on the aperture unconditionally
`publishRestoredProduct` is the one publish site that does not bump `resultVersion`, and every display cache is keyed on it
`applyDPCDisplay` returns nil for two different facts — "the display was published" and "this did not run"
Colormaps.lutRGBA traps (not returns garbage) for count <= 1
PendingLoad owns a security-scoped URL and a live read Task but has no deinit; release depends entirely on two AppState call sites
Quantitative iDPC forces a square scan step even when the two scan axes are sampled differently
The sampled-preview label the file's own invariant I4 calls load-bearing prints "every 32th position"
DatasetPreview.make reports two non-allocation failures as FourDError.allocationFailed
Full-scan progress fractions can be delivered out of order, and the tile coalescer admits the regression
fit2D and fitOrigin(included:) index by width*height without checking the array actually has that many elements
OriginCalibration.run is dead in the app and duplicates tiledRun's calibration logic
Q high-pass envelope is applied although py4DSTEM's aberration_correct ignores it
ProbeKernel.measured traps on a non-finite origin where its sibling .flat returns nil
RotationCalibration.solve reads 2*width*height floats from com without checking its length
Analytic aperture kernel and the mask path disagree on the exact-centre detector pixel when inner radius is 0
Blocking whole-cube compute and the on-screen MTKView renders share one MTLCommandQueue, so a long dispatch serialises ahead of the display command buffers
The CIF importer's family-classification tolerance is 1000× looser than the model validation it feeds, so a band of cells is rejected with a generic message that hides the real reason
A singular metric tensor silently yields latInv = latReal — a reciprocal lattice in Å instead of Å⁻¹, with no error
ACOM's radial coordinate is the projected radius on a continuous kMax/nRadial axis where py4DSTEM uses discrete |g| shells — a second un-DEVIATION-noted port difference in the same function
Restoring an RGBA result map computes width*height*4 after a guard that only bounds width*height
Preserved results are re-keyed by kind, so two saved results whose kind attribute is missing collapse into one and the second is dropped without a word
An orphaned result_* node is copied as an opaque 'external object' and then collides with a new result of the same kind, wedging every future save
Result and calibration array sizes are taken from the file with no upper bound, so a damaged sidecar traps on allocation instead of erroring
`originFitIsSane` passes vacuously when no probe radius is set, and the reciprocal-metrology gate does not require one
`CalibrationInvalidation.Field.probeRadius` and `.ellipse` are never produced, so two session-restore guards can never fire
DM4Error.unsupportedDataType is never thrown; an unsupported pixel type is reported to the user as "no datacube found"
FourDArray.scanTile validates only the tile's element count and row range, not its declared scan/detector extents
H5 EMD dim-vector calibration infers pixel size from the first two samples only, with no uniformity check and a silent drop for descending axes
A sidecar with no recorded ptychography method is rehydrated as gradient-descent and reported as an applied setting
cancelCurrent() cannot distinguish "already cancelling" from "nothing was running", and the controller keeps reporting a live operation after cancel
`LearnedDetectionSession.prepare` has a check-then-await gap that can load and compile the Core ML model twice
A session with no recorded origin makes `apply` invent an aperture centre in the wrong frame and can emit a false "beam is not inside this diffraction crop" refusal
The Bragg-peak CSV export carries no units, no calibration and no frame, so a CSV from a cropped or binned view is indistinguishable from a full-extent one
Region-radius Slider forms an inverted range on a scan whose larger axis is a single pixel
A full-pattern log10 transform runs on the main thread inside a SwiftUI view body, for a histogram that is inside a DisclosureGroup collapsed by default
TB1StallProbeTests is inert everywhere: every test in the file skips on a hard-coded absolute path inside the owner's home directory
`tools/lib/python.sh`'s last-resort fallback accepts a `python3` with numpy but no scipy, contradicting the candidate loop it comments
A Metal parameter struct governed by the byte-identity hard rule is duplicated in a tools/ harness, outside the one file the rule names
